content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been filed, while resubmission would not correct the authorization defect and patient billing is not supported as contractual patient responsibility. With no compliant automated action available and only 15 days remaining in the 120-day collection window, specialist follow-up is required."}
